run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate animated gifs from trajectory files
run_parallelized_generation: run parallelized gif generation from a trajectory file using multiple worker processes
run_pov_from_atoms: run povray rendering of a single atoms frame to generate a POV snapshot image
review_parallelize_generation: review the parallelize_generation function that reads trajectories and spawns multiprocessing workers for image generation
refactor_pov_from_atoms: refactor the pov_from_atoms function to customize surface replication, bounding box, or povray rendering settings
